first-call-demo.title: A first call in DEMO
first-call-demo.description: Signed out on a phone: the terminal's tour, then UP on BTC and CLOSE, on paper at the live book's price.

chapters.title: Open the terminal
chapters.text: Signed out, it trades paper dollars on live prices.

chapters.title: Skip the tour
chapters.text: Five steps explain the line, UP and DOWN, the value pill, Trail and Close.

chapters.title: Wait for the book
chapters.text: UP lights once someone is on the other side at this size.

chapters.title: Tap UP
chapters.text: A paper call fills at the live book's price.

chapters.title: Watch what it's worth
chapters.text: The pill shows what CLOSE pays now.

chapters.title: Close it
chapters.text: CLOSE sells it back at what the book pays.

proof-reverify.title: Re-verify a settled Window
proof-reverify.description: From the leaderboard to a trader's record to a settled Window's proof, then the closing print re-verified in the browser against the chain.

chapters.title: Open the leaderboard
chapters.text: Records ranked from their settled calls.

chapters.title: Open a record
chapters.text: Each row links its calls and their proofs.

chapters.title: Open a proof
chapters.text: The verdict, the settlement transaction and both signed prints.

chapters.title: Re-verify the close
chapters.text: The browser reads the recording transaction and asks the verifier contract again.

chapters.title: Verified
chapters.text: The close passes twice: its record transaction and the archive. This open is the previous Window's close.
